parties: Liyanage Danushka Sandamali De Silva v. Bank of Ceylon and Others Liyanage Danushka Sandamali De Silva v. Bank of Ceylon and Others View More
keywords: The Petitioner, an alleged third-party mortgager, sought to quash the Board Resolution and the notice of Auction Sale to sell the property in suit issued by the 1st Respondent for default of the loan taken by the 10th Respondent. Held - Petitioner was aware of the default and deadline to repay loan, and was the Director of the 10th Respondent. Application dismissed without costs.
